summary: Polygon's guide to the best Barbarian builds in Diablo 4 season 2, covering a leveling build (from Lexyu at IcyVeins) and a Double Swing endgame build (from AaronActionRPG at IcyVeins). It lists skill orders, Weapon Expertise and Arsenal choices, Aspects, Vampiric Powers and Paragon Board glyphs. It closes with the four core Barbarian build ideas: Fury dumping, weapon swapping, Bleed and Berserk, each tied to a Key Passive.
one_line: Polygon guide to Diablo 4 season 2 Barbarian builds: a Hammer of the Ancients leveling build and a Double Swing endgame build, plus build-design principles.
key_facts: The leveling build is based on Lexyu's Barbarian leveling guide at IcyVeins and covers allocating 58 skill points between levels 1 and 50.
The leveling build uses Hammer of the Ancients as its primary skill, plus Frenzy, Death Blow, Rallying Cry, Leap and Wrath of the Berserker.
For leveling, the two-handed sword goes in the Technique slot of Weapon Expertise so Hammer of the Ancients damage makes enemies Bleed.
Leveling Aspects come from three Scosglen dungeons: Aspect of Ancestral Force (Sunken Ruins), Aspect of the Expectant (Underroot) and Edgemaster's Aspect (Oldstones).
The Double Swing endgame build is based on AaronActionRPG's guide at IcyVeins and assumes over level 50, all 58 skill points and progress on Paragon Boards.
The Double Swing build uses Double Swing as its core skill, along with Steel Grasp, Ground Stomp, Iron Maelstrom, Charge and Lunging Strike.
The Double Swing build takes One-Handed Mace in the Arsenal system's Technique slot.
Season 2 adds 22 class-agnostic Vampiric Powers, with five extra slots per character.
AaronActionRPG recommends the Vampiric Powers Anticipation, Prey on the Weak, Ravenous, Domination and Metamorphosis, requiring Pacts of 8 Ferocity, 3 Divinity and 2 Eternity.
The Paragon Glyphs for Double Swing should be leveled to 15 in this order: Exploit, Territorial, Ambidextrous, Might, Wrath, Bloodfeeder, Ire.
Barbarians are Diablo 4's only pure melee class, and their weapon-swapping system gives them more Legendary powers than any other class.
Fury dump builds use the Unbridled Rage Key Passive, making Fury spenders cost double Fury but deal more than double damage.
The four main Barbarian build ideas are Fury dumping, weapon swapping (Walking Arsenal), Bleed (Gushing Wounds) and Berserk (Unconstrained).
